patch_description: Extend the existing multi-start greedy + move-based local search with two additional neighborhood operators: (1) 1-for-1 swaps between the hot (max-KVPR) GPU and any other GPU, and (2) 2-for-1 exchanges where one model on the hot GPU is replaced by two smaller models from another GPU (and vice versa). Each candidate is checked for memory feasibility, and accepted only if the resulting global max KVPR strictly improves by >1e-12. This handles size-vs-rate asymmetries that moves alone cannot fix (e.g., the hot GPU holds a large low-rate model while another GPU holds two small high-rate models).
